title: New Murree Development Authority Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: New Murree Development Authority Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 2004
ACT XVII OF 2004
NEW MURREE
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An act to amend
the New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004.
[Gazette of Punjab
Extraordinary, 17th June, 2004.]
No.PAP-Legis-2(11)/2004/633,
dated 16-6-2004.---The New Murree Development Authority (Amendment) Bill
2004, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 3rd
June, 2004, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 14th
June, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Act may be called the New Murree Development
Authority (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
